features.what: Channel volume replaces group volume on the Status page
features.detail: One slider per output, range -400..0 tenths dB (DSP's own DP12_OutputGain/-40.0..0.0 limits, protocol section 15, where 0 dB = full level). Sliders seed from the device's stored per-output levels (the active memory's tune) via seedVolume() after every channel-data load; release writes the complete 16-entry cmd 11 block through chSend, preserving all other channels. Note line states the source memory.
features.removed: Group A-D sliders, Apply volume button, Output mask row (cmd 18 machinery retired from the UI; /api/volume endpoint still exists).
features.safety: applyMaster/applySource/applyMemory now send groups from S.groupDb (device mirror seeded at connect) because DoMaster zeroes all four groups when the array is omitted (protocol section 12).

features.detail: GET /api/tunes lists *.idsp in the web folder; POST /api/tunes/delete {name} removes one. Name validated hard (no separators, no leading dot, .idsp suffix, <=128 chars) plus full-path containment check. Page dropdown is now built from /api/tunes at load (refreshTuneList), Delete-this-tune chip with window.confirm; clears preview if the deleted tune was loaded.
Copied from Downloads to web folder (327974 bytes); appears via the dynamic list.
